entities.summary: Nica Noelle is an American entrepreneur, pornographic film actress and director, as well as a writer whose essays have appeared in Salon.com, HuffPost and Hustler. She is the co-founder of adult film studios Sweetheart Video, Sweet Sinner, Sweet Sinema, Girl Candy Films, Rock Candy films, Hot Candy Films, and TransRomantic Films.
